title: 第二十三章 秦天讲道第二十四章 获得崇明花
slug: 震惊我的徒弟居然是女帝
content_zh:
晚上吃饭的时候，又多了一个人。
明依莲羞涩的摘下面纱吃饭。
当秦天看清楚明依莲容貌时，也呆了一下，虽然比安妙菱，白筱如稍逊一点点。
但是也是难得的超级大美女。
也怪不得周帝愿意用自己国家三分之一的城池当聘礼，迎娶明依莲。
看着秦天盯着明依莲看，安妙菱有些不喜，银牙轻咬，玉手在桌下狠狠的掐了一下秦天的腰。
传音道：“你能不能淡定一点，看到个美女就这样，难道我不美吗？”
秦天连忙把掐他的手抓在手里，抚摸了两下，传音道，“你是最美的，半个月他就走了，你就大方一点！”
安妙菱小脸微红，这才发现自己情绪有些不对。
于是连忙抽回手开始吃肉。
今天吃的是金龙肉，明依莲一碗肉汤下肚后整个人愣住了。
“因为她感觉有股庞大的能量在体力席卷开来，滋润着她的肉身。”
“甚至她感觉自己造化境的瓶颈开始松动了，很快就可以突破了。”
随后明依莲又吃了一碗，便盘地而坐开始尝试突破。
安妙菱看到明依莲开始突破很羡慕，她也想尽快提升自己。
去解决自己的仇家。
她的几个仇家，全部都有强大的帝境存在。
接下来几天，安妙菱修炼更加努力了。
基本上除了睡觉吃饭都在修炼，但是她的剑意却迟迟没有达到圆满。
这让她有些急躁，她想尽快达到圆满，然后开始领悟剑域。

如果领悟了剑域，她只需要达到圣境就可以凭借冰璃剑和帝境一战。
但是剑意完全要靠领悟，太急了，反而适得其反。
秦天这些天也看明白了，于是他把安妙菱叫停。
等明依莲突破后，他把两人一狐叫到一起开始讲道。
这也是他在他化自在大法中领悟到了。
“意境有三重境界。”
“第一重是看山是山，看水是水，这些你们应该知道。”
“简单来说就是就是看其本源，山就是山，水就是水，保持本心即可。”
“第二重是看山不是山，看水不是水。”
“这一重里面你们不仅仅要看本源，还要看清楚其背后隐藏的东西，这里面或许充满了诱惑或者艰难，而你们要做的就是明心见性，不能迷失其中。”
“第三重则是返璞归真，把你以前所学，所悟好好的梳理，不断的反省，让自己有一个更清晰的认知。”
“这样才算圆满，你也就能完全掌握意境。”
content_en:
At dinner time in the evening, there was one more person.
Ming Yilian shyly took off her veil to eat.
When Qin Tian saw Ming Yilian's appearance clearly, he was stunned for a moment, although it was slightly inferior to An Miaoling and Bai Xiaoru.
But she is also a rare super beauty.
No wonder Emperor Zhou was willing to use one-third of his country's city as a betrothal gift to marry Ming Yilian.
Seeing Qin Tian staring at Ming Yilian, An Miaoling was a little unhappy. She bit her teeth lightly and pinched Qin Tian's waist hard under the table.
The voice transmission said: "Can you calm down a little? If you see a beautiful woman like this, am I not beautiful?"
Qin Tian quickly took the hand that was pinching him, stroked it twice, and said through a message, "You are the most beautiful. He left in half a month, so you should be more generous!"
An Miaoling's face turned slightly red, and then she realized that something was wrong with her mood.
So he quickly pulled his hand back and started eating the meat.
What I ate today was golden dragon meat. Ming Yilian was stunned after eating a bowl of broth.
"Because she felt a huge energy sweeping through her body, nourishing her body."
"She even feels that the bottleneck of her creation realm is beginning to loosen, and she will soon be able to break through."
Then Ming Yilian ate another bowl, then sat cross-legged on the floor and started trying to break through.
An Miaoling was envious when she saw Ming Yilian starting to break through, and she also wanted to improve herself as soon as possible.
To deal with your enemies.
Several of her enemies all have powerful imperial realms.
In the next few days, An Miaoling practiced harder.
Basically, she practiced except sleeping and eating, but her sword intention has not yet reached perfection.
This made her a little impatient. She wanted to reach perfection as soon as possible and then start to understand the sword realm.
If she understands the Sword Realm, she only needs to reach the Holy Realm to fight against the Imperial Realm with the Ice Glass Sword.
However, sword intention completely depends on comprehension. If you are too hasty, it will be counterproductive.
Qin Tian also understood it these days, so he asked An Miaoling to stop.
After Ming Yilian broke through, he called the two of them together and started preaching.
This is what he also realized in the Dharma of Self-Transformation.
"There are three realms of artistic conception."
"The first level is to see if mountains are mountains and if water is water, you should know these."
"To put it simply, it means looking at its origin. Mountains are mountains and water is water. Just keep your heart."
"The second level is to look at mountains but not mountains, and to look at water not as water."
"In this stage, you must not only see the origin, but also clearly see what is hidden behind it. It may be full of temptations or difficulties, but what you have to do is to see clearly and not get lost in it."
"The third level is to return to nature, sort out what you have learned and understood before, and constantly reflect on it to give yourself a clearer understanding."
"This way it is complete and you can fully grasp the artistic conception."
